name: securecontract-ai
description: A REST API that analyzes contract text for risky clauses and missing protections, using [LangChain.js](https://js.langchain.com/) and Google Gemini. This is **Phase 1 (Beginner)** of a three-part build — a working, documented, containerized API with one real Gemini integration and no testing/auth/rate limiting yet (see [Roadmap](#roadmap)).
